**Sacramento Stockton Blvd Grant Application: Glocks and Fried Chicken (GAFC)**

To the Sacramento Stockton Blvd Grant Committee,

Glocks and Fried Chicken (GAFC), a minority-owned social enterprise, respectfully requests a **$15,000** grant from the Sacramento Stockton Blvd Grant to bolster gun safety education within Sacramento's communities of color. Our mission addresses the critical need for accessible, culturally relevant gun safety resources to mitigate preventable tragedies.

Communities of color along the Stockton Blvd corridor and throughout Sacramento disproportionately experience gun violence and accidental shootings. These incidents often stem from a lack of proactive, culturally competent safety education, leaving families vulnerable. Traditional educational approaches frequently fail to resonate, highlighting an urgent demand for innovative solutions that genuinely connect with residents.

GAFC tackles this challenge through a multi-faceted approach. Our **"Gloxsie 21" cartoon IP** offers engaging, age-appropriate gun safety lessons for youth, building crucial foundational knowledge. We complement this with **AI education**, empowering community members with critical thinking and future-forward skills applicable to modern safety challenges. Our cornerstone **Community Workshops**, conducted in partnership with the trusted Church of Legacy, provide practical, hands-on training in responsible gun storage, safe handling, and conflict resolution within familiar, supportive environments.

Expected outcomes include a measurable increase in gun safety literacy, a reduction in accidental gun incidents among participating families, and enhanced community resilience. By empowering residents with vital knowledge, we foster safer homes and neighborhoods.

GAFC is uniquely qualified as a minority-owned organization deeply rooted in the communities we serve, ensuring our strategies are authentic and impactful. Our robust partnership with the respected Church of Legacy amplifies our reach and credibility. With a blend of innovative intellectual property, essential tech education, and hands-on workshops, GAFC provides a holistic, community-centric solution. This grant will enable us to significantly enhance public safety and well-being along this vital corridor and beyond.
